why: The route page says the Ellingwood Col crossing is steep snow year-round and the glacier is only one bail-off option, so the line itself is unsettled.

This Wind River Dog's Tooth route starts up a snowfield to cracks and descends by a walk-off to Lizard Meadows or rappels to the snowfield, with no glacier on the line.

A June ascent booted a long snow stretch and descended the Teepe Glacier, but the page says nothing about crevasses or roping.
The page lists axe and crampons only depending on the season and never mentions a glacier, which is silence rather than proof.

This is the Wind River Watchtower in the Cirque of the Towers, reached in 30 to 40 minutes from camp with no glacier on the approach or line.
